title: Samsung Ads North America vendor breach, Nov 2026
also_called: the Samsung smart TV data leak
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Samsung, Cybernews, Android Headlines, DailySecu, KPI News, The Asia Business Daily, Seoul Economic Daily, Multicampus, Samsung Securities, The Hankyoreh, Yonhap or any other company, news outlet, government agency, or anyone else named.
size_basis: About 220MB posted, per Cybernews: roughly 150,000 TV viewing events, 42,600 political ad records and 99,100 AI training records. Samsung has not said how much was affected.
who_is_affected: Not yet clear. The dump is said to hold smart TV viewing events with city and ZIP code, and political ad records, from Samsung's North America advertising business. Samsung says scope is still being worked out with the vendor.

known.text: Samsung says a third-party vendor for Samsung Ads North America was involved.
Samsung says the vendor's early findings show some Samsung information may have been affected.

not_known.text: What data was really taken; the contents come from Cybernews, not Samsung.
